title: Add tests for the csmil route
body:
## Summary
- Add 5 tests for the `/i/<path>.csmil/master.m3u8` route covering cache hit, cache miss, segment registration, 404 on missing source, and deep path parsing
- Fix test config in both test classes to use configparser (matching real app) so getboolean works correctly

## Test plan
- [x] All 7 route tests pass (2 existing ABR + 5 new csmil)
- [x] No source code modified, only test file changed
